title: Tiatorian Client 🛂
description: A Modpack with optimization and QOL
body:
This modpack was made a long time ago, but is still packed with awesome QOL and visuals no other modpack has combined! This modpack has been updates and tested over the course of years by KittensCanCode (me), someone who started playing Minecraft so long ago he can't even remember! Starting with Legacy and Bedrock, we have Essential and Sword blocking (but it is client-side + requires a shield.) Has support for optifine features but having better fps via Sodium and Lithium. Has a never seen before combination of visual mods, making the game look better. This modpack will make your Minecraft Experience more modern!

Summary:

A 1.21.1 modpack with client-side mods - beware as some mods might get you banned from some servers

Has QOL mods including, Quick Chat, Resend, and Controllify

Has Visual Mods, like Iris and Chunks Fade In.

Has optimzation including, Sodium, Lithium, Entity Culling, and Ferrite Core.

Has free Multiplayer Support with Essential!

And more!

50+ Mods!

_I do not have any plans to update this modpack to later versions_

_For people who don't like Essential, there is world host_

_Hypixel doesn't work with this modpack, a certain version may work but I don't know_
